name: Omnibus
source:
"Welcome. Care for a spot of tea?"

The commanding officer of the organization known as Idea. After a seemingly random encounter, she becomes deeply involved with Cardia. She is a gentle soul who loves nature, peace, and harmony.

[Taken from [url=http://aksysgames.com/code-realize/]the official website[/url]]

Age: Unknown
